en.headline: Seven-year-old boy dies in first fatal paediatric flu case of 2026
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the previously healthy child, who had received the seasonal vaccine, died on Tuesday after developing shock and encephalopathy from influenza A (H3).
body: Hong Kong recorded its first fatal paediatric influenza case of 2026 after a seven-year-old boy died on Tuesday, the Centre for Health Protection said.

The boy, who had been in good health and had received the 2025-26 seasonal influenza vaccination, developed a cough and runny nose on 27 July and a fever on Saturday. His condition deteriorated on Monday when he became less responsive and was admitted in critical condition to the paediatric intensive care unit at Princess Margaret Hospital.

A respiratory specimen tested positive for influenza A (H3) virus. He was diagnosed with influenza A infection complicated by shock and encephalopathy and died on Tuesday. A household contact had earlier tested positive for influenza and recovered after a mild illness; the boy himself had not travelled during the incubation period.

The Centre for Health Protection urged high-risk groups including children, the elderly and those with chronic illnesses to wear surgical masks on public transport and in crowded places, and reminded parents to seek immediate medical attention if a child with influenza develops shortness of breath, confusion, persistent fever or convulsions. Influenza activity is expected to remain elevated in the coming weeks.

zh.headline: 七歲男童感染甲型流感不治 成今年首宗兒童死亡個案
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心表示，該名過往健康良好並已接種季節性流感疫苗的男童，周二因甲型流感（H3）併發休克及腦病變死亡。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，本港錄得2026年首宗兒童流感死亡個案，一名七歲男童于周二不治。
男童過往健康良好，並已接種2025-26年度季節性流感疫苗。他于7月27日出現咳嗽及流鼻水，周六發燒，周一情況轉差、反應變慢，危殆入住瑪嘉烈醫院兒童深切治療部。
呼吸道樣本對甲型流感（H3）病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感感染併發休克及腦病變，周二不治。家中一名接觸者較早前曾感染流感，經輕微病徵後康復；男童在潛伏期內並無外遊。
中心呼籲兒童、長者及長期病患者等高危人士在乘搭公共交通或到人多擠迫地方時佩戴外科口罩，並提醒家長如發現兒童出現氣促、意識混亂、持續高燒或抽搐等情況，須立即求醫。預料未來數周流感活躍程度仍會維持在較高水平。
